text:
Sam: Quick follow-up from design review — noticed the docs sidecar shows breadcrumb 'Docs > Console' but the in-panel heading says 'Help & Tips'. Might be confusing on mobile where breadcrumb is hidden.
Rhea: Good call. For small screens the breadcrumb collapses; we should put the canonical label in the header so the user knows whether they're in-app or going to the external docs.
Omar: Propose header: 'Help (Console)' and footer CTA: 'Open full docs' with an external icon. Also ensure CTA is pinned to bottom on mobile so it doesn't scroll away.
Tess: Accessibility: CTA needs aria-label 'Open full docs, opens in new tab'; make sure the mobile fixed footer doesn't trap focus or obscure inputs.
Sam: Also noticed a spacing token mismatch: footer CTA uses spacing-sm in code but Figma uses spacing-xs — causes a visual wobble across builds. Rhea can we align tokens?
Rhea: Yep, will update the design token and push to the component library. Also change the external icon to 16px to match other inline icons.
Omar: Dev checklist:
- change header text to 'Help (Console)'
- footer CTA href -> /docs/console/<topic>?source=sidecar_mobile target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer
- pin CTA as fixed footer at mobile breakpoints but keep it out of the tab order unless opened
- add role="contentinfo" to the footer and ensure screen readers announce the link purpose
- include visual snapshots for 360px and 768px widths
Tess: Tests: keyboard + screenreader flow in mobile emulator; confirm focus moves to CTA and back to trigger on close. Also test that collapsed breadcrumb doesn't remove context for screen reader users.
release-bot: Reminder: add a changelog entry and mark this for the canary release window.
Sam: I'll own rollout coordination and add a short support KB note explaining the label and mobile fix to cut down on tickets.
Rhea: I'll update Figma, the i18n context note for translators, and upload the revised tokens.
Omar: I'll open a PR with the changes and attach mobile screenshots. Branch: feature/sidecar-mobile-cta.
Tess: Thanks — tagging @accessibility and @docs for review when PR is ready.
Sam: Great. Target next patch. Closing thread once PR merged and canary looks good.
